title: What if you were dropped into a zombie outbreak in England

shots.text: You've got ten minutes before London is overrun.
First, forget guns. In England, your best weapon is a cricket bat.
Don't go near the Tube. It's a tunnel full of dead ends.
Grab a bike. The roads will be jammed, and bikes are quiet.
You could do what Shaun did: go to the Winchester and wait for it all to blow over.
That didn't work. So head for a castle. England has hundreds, built to keep people out.
Thick stone walls, one way in, and most had their own well for water.
So... which castle are you running to?

youtube.title: What If a Zombie Outbreak Hit England? 🧟🇬🇧 #shorts
youtube.description:
You've got ten minutes before London is overrun 🧟 Here's how you'd survive in England.

Forget guns: UK gun laws are strict, so a cricket bat is about the best you'll find. Stay out of the Tube, because tunnels are full of dead ends. Grab a bike, because the roads will be jammed. And don't do what Shaun did…

Instead, head for a castle. England has hundreds of them, built to keep people out, with thick stone walls, one way in and often their own well for water.

🏰 Which castle are you running to? Tell me in the comments.
